system.description:
• Effect: Cast arcane spells using your slots.
  • Each time you unlock a slot level you gain two spells of that level: your Path spell (see Patron Paths) and one spell of your choice from the Warlock list in Spellcasting in Arneyan.
  • You may cast any spell you know with any slot of its level or higher.
  • Slots are shared with Pact Summons — see Spell Slot Progression above.
